name: Desktop Commander Free / Pro / Team prototype
definitionOfDone: Requested behavior is verified, intended changes are integrated into prototype/free-pro-team, the exact prototype SHA is verified, required documentation/Work Log is current, and no unauthorized deploy or merge to main occurred.
constraints: Drive is the authority for approved decisions and project history.
main remains a clean fast-forwardable upstream mirror.
Never merge prototype/free-pro-team into main without explicit user approval.
Preserve upstream allowed directories, path validation, blocked commands, command validation and other security guardrails.
Deploy only after explicit user authorization; live verification is required after an authorized deploy.
Do not store secrets, raw file contents for approval, or raw terminal commands in workflow evidence.

stages.label: Drive pre-read
stages.description: Read the Roadmap & Work Log and relevant Drive documentation before material work.

stages.label: Work Log start
stages.description: Record task start and scope in the Roadmap & Work Log.

stages.label: Repo / upstream audit
stages.description: Verify branch, status, remotes, upstream and unrelated work before editing.

stages.label: Graphify architecture check
stages.description: Use Graphify when it materially helps discover call paths or blast radius; confirm findings in source.

stages.label: Root-cause / design analysis
stages.description: Analyze root cause, affected flow, upstream behavior and security/privacy implications.

stages.label: RED → GREEN
stages.description: Establish the smallest meaningful RED and turn it GREEN when practical.

stages.label: Implementation
stages.description: Make the smallest coherent implementation while preserving upstream architecture and guardrails.

stages.label: Verification
stages.description: Run focused tests, broader regressions, build/typecheck/lint and real MCP side-effect checks as applicable.

stages.label: Diff / security review
stages.description: Review full diff, unrelated changes, security/privacy implications and git diff --check.

stages.label: Commit / push
stages.description: Commit the reviewed task branch and push it without force rewriting.

stages.label: CI / PR
stages.description: Use CI and a PR for substantial work where practical; do not target main with prototype work.

stages.label: Integrate into prototype
stages.description: Integrate the reviewed change into prototype/free-pro-team.

stages.label: Verify prototype SHA
stages.description: Verify the exact authoritative prototype SHA and intended change.

stages.label: Post-merge CI
stages.description: Verify intended CI/workflows on the exact integrated prototype SHA; while CI is running record waiting_external and re-check before advancing.

stages.label: Documentation / Work Log sync
stages.description: Update durable docs and Work Log with implementation, verification, limitations and next state.

stages.label: Active Work Registry cleanup
stages.description: Remove the completed active-work entry only after authoritative integration, intended verification, and durable Work Log/docs are complete.

stages.label: Deploy
stages.description: Deploy only when explicitly authorized by the user.

stages.label: Live verification
stages.description: After an authorized deploy, verify actual live behavior; otherwise skip explicitly.

stages.label: Final report
stages.description: Report task/root cause, docs read, repo state, RED→GREEN, changes, verification, commit/PR/CI, prototype SHA, deploy status and blockers.
